title: Chicken 'N Pasta Primavera
description: Sliced chicken breast and a blend of veggies are simmered until just done in a creamy Alfredo sauce with fettuccine.
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken, thinly sliced
1 (12 ounce) bag Birds Eye® Recipe Ready Primavera Blend
8 ounces fettuccine, cooked according to package directions

steps.text: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken, stirring occasionally, 8 minutes or until almost done. Remove chicken from pan.

Add Recipe Ready Primavera Blend and cook, stirring frequently, 5 minutes or until just tender. Stir in pasta sauce and bring to a boil. Add fettuccine and chicken and toss to coat.* Serve, if desired, with additional parmesan cheese and season with black pepper.
